name: Nihongo Master v1.1.3
changelog: v1.1.3: Expanded 3D Hiragana Cards up to Stage 8 with an escalating difficulty curve. Features 8 full stages (Basic Vowels, Consonant Lines, Lookalikes, Dakuten, Handakuten, Sokuon/Glottal Stops, Compound Words, and Grand Master Gauntlet) with intelligent confusable decoy traps, dedicated 8-stage selector ribbon and briefings in the main launcher, smooth stage transitions, and victory fanfare.
